mainEntity.name: Can I install D-shaped handles myself or should I hire a professional in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's possible to install D-shaped handles as a DIY project, precision is key. Misaligned holes or incorrect placement can damage cabinet fronts, which can be costly to repair. For a flawless, uniform look, especially across numerous cabinets, hiring a professional general contractor in the Bay Area, like City Dweller, LLC, is recommended. They have the right tools and expertise for accurate and efficient installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY installation is possible, but precision is vital to avoid cabinet damage. For a flawless result, hiring a professional in the Bay Area is recommended.
